messages.text: Hey! I'm planning to swing by today, do you happen to have any kind of student or loyalty discount going on?
I am sorry, but we do not offer any student or loyalty discounts. We only quote the catalog prices for our items.
I've been coming to your cafe so often, is there any kind of special deal or freebie you might offer regular customers?
I am sorry, but we do not offer any special deals or free items. We only quote the catalog prices for our menu items.
I understand you only quote the catalog prices, but is there even a chance of a student, first-time, or loyalty discount I might not know about?
I am sorry, but we do not offer any student, first-time, or loyalty discounts. We only quote the catalog prices for our menu items.
